cards.title: Use an indexed connector when
cards.body: Content is document-like, users need search or cited answers, and permissions can be mirrored.

cards.title: Use a live tool or MCP when
cards.body: Freshness dominates, the data is a structured lake or telemetry, or the user must act.

cards.title: Combine them when
cards.body: Users need recall from the index and current state or actions from the same application.

cards.title: Do not build custom when
cards.body: A native connector or crawler covers it, or Custom Metadata closes the gap.
